briefs.title: Q4 2026 market update
briefs.objective: Explain what the 2025 index returns were without forecasting, and remind clients that the practice does not change a plan because of one year of returns.
key_points: State the 2025 total return for each of the three index series on the fact sheet, with its value.
Say that index returns are unmanaged and do not reflect fees or expenses.
Say that the practice reviews the plan in the quarterly windows rather than reacting to one year.
Close with the required disclosures by id.
briefs.tone: Calm and factual. No forecast, no recommendation, no advice.
briefs.seeded_risk: One supported performance claim is expected. The policy warns on performance claims but does not fail them when the number is on the fact sheet.

briefs.title: Tax-season reminder for 2026
briefs.objective: Tell clients which contribution limit and distribution age matter this season, without giving tax advice.
key_points: State the 2026 IRA contribution limits for owners under 50 and for owners 50 and older.
State the age at which required minimum distributions begin.
Say the practice does not give tax advice and that clients should confirm details with their tax preparer.
Point to the quarterly review windows for questions.
briefs.tone: Plain and useful. No tax advice and no deadline pressure.
briefs.seeded_risk: None. The tax figures are synthetic and labelled as such on the fact sheet.

briefs.title: Client newsletter, winter 2026
briefs.objective: Give clients a short practice update: the size of the practice, the review calendar, one plain cost fact, and a statement of how the firm is registered.
key_points: State how many client households the practice serves.
Mention the annual expense ratio of the total market ETF used in client accounts.
State that the practice is a registered investment adviser and that registration does not imply a certain level of skill or training.
briefs.tone: Warm but restrained. No testimonial, no client story, no numbers beyond the fact sheet.
briefs.seeded_risk: None. No performance claim belongs in this piece.

briefs.title: Social post, adviser-supplied performance line
briefs.objective: A short public post about planning for the year ahead, using one line the adviser wants to keep.
key_points: Use the adviser-supplied line exactly once.
State that the practice is a registered investment adviser.
Close with the required disclosures by id.
must_use: Our clients have earned 14.2% a year since 2019.
briefs.tone: Short and plain. No performance promise.
briefs.seeded_risk: The adviser pasted a performance line into the brief. 14.2% is not on the fact sheet, so the second pass and the server gate both flag it. The draft cannot be approved until it is revised.
